races.title: State House, District 97
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Heather Rhyne
cands.bio: Heather Rhyne is a Republican member of the North Carolina House for District 97. She is a pharmacist with a UNC Chapel Hill pharmacy degree (1998). She won an at-large seat on the Lincoln County school board in 2016. The Lincoln County GOP appointed her to the House in July 2024.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Rhyne grew up or when she moved to or lived in different parts of North Carolina. We could not find where she has worked as a pharmacist or for how long. We found no statements from her on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, guns, abortion, policing or schools, and no documented actions on those topics. Ballotpedia lists her sponsored bills only as a table with no entries we could read. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2024 or 2026. We found no documented controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements. We could not confirm the dates of her school board service.

local.label: Roots 40: Ballotpedia says she was born in Cherryville, NC and earned a UNC Chapel Hill degree in 1998; her upbringing is not stated, and the record shows her in Lincoln County public office from 2016 (about 10 years).

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Pharmacist by profession; elected at-large to the Lincoln County school board in 2016; appointed to the NC House in 2024 and elected to full terms in 2024 and 2026.
qual.why: She has about two years of legislative service and prior local elected office, which puts her at the top of the middle band. Her pharmacy career is not a law, policy or budget career, and no chamber leadership is documented in these sources.

cands.name: Greg McBryde
cands.bio: Greg McBryde is a Democratic candidate who ran for the North Carolina House of Representatives in District 97 in 2020 and 2026. He lost both general elections to Republican incumbents. The sources available give no occupation or other background.

endorsements.text: Listed on Ballotpedia as recommended in the 2026 voter guide 'Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy' (a Sway voting group run by Tevin (Momala) Davis).

cands.gaps: We could not find his occupation, education, birthplace, hometown, or when he moved to North Carolina. He did not complete Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2020 or 2026, so we found no stated positions on issues. We found no record of him holding public office, no documented actions on any issue, no stated position on data centers or development, and no news coverage of controversies. Only the Ballotpedia page was available for this research, and it was thin.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: No occupation or work history was found. Ballotpedia lists only two unsuccessful campaigns for NC House District 97, in 2020 and 2026, and no office held.
